facts: Rocket engines ignite and rocket rises above a canal city.
A woman has a mechanical right hand; dialogue carries their argument.

Technicians inspect a brain covered in electrodes.

speechReference.text: You're a jerk, Thom.
Look Celia, we have to follow our passions;
...you have your robotics, and I just want to be awesome in space.
Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?
I'm not freaked out by- it's...
...alright! Fine!
I'm freaked out! I have nightmares that I'm being chased...
...by these giant robotic claws of death...
"Fourty years later" Whatever, Thom. We're done.
Robot's memory synced and locked!
This is pretty freaky.

referenceAmendment.reason: The last pre-run fact overinterpreted sampled frames. The visible exterior street, not the laboratory, becomes a simulated sunny canal town. Correction was informed by output inspection and is not a blinded reference.
referenceAmendment.originalFact: The laboratory transforms into a simulated room with a woman in front of the group.
